summary: Haven is a Rails self-hosted personal blogging platform (posts, comments, likes) with a built-in RSS reader (feeds/feed_entries updated by a background job) and IndieWeb endpoints (IndieAuth OAuth2 authorization-code flow with PKCE, Micropub post creation/update/delete/media, Microsub feed follow/timeline), admin multi-role user accounts (subscriber/publisher/admin), a singleton settings record, and login-link passwordless sign-in.

internal model helper; no wire entry, no guards, calls nothing (app/models/login_link.rb:6)
